title: MOBO-CAPS: Multi-Objective Bayesian Optimization with Cardinality-Aware Pareto Selection
abstract: arXiv:2611.19999v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-objective Bayesian optimization (MOBO) traditionally aims to approximate the entire Pareto front, but, due to resource constraints, real-world deployment is often limited to testing a small, representative subset of solutions. Hence current methods first approximate the full front before selecting solutions, potentially wasting costly evaluations. We formalize this problem as Multi-objective Bayesian Optimization with Cardinality-aware Pareto Selection (MOBO-CAPS), where the goal is to identify a set of exactly M solutions with high hypervolume. translated_title: MOBO-CAPS：基于基数感知帕累托选择的多目标贝叶斯优化
translated_abstract: 多目标贝叶斯优化（MOBO）传统上旨在近似整个帕累托前沿，但由于资源限制，现实世界的部署往往只能测试一小部分具有代表性的解。因此，现有方法通常先近似完整前沿再选择解，这可能浪费昂贵的评估资源。我们将该问题形式化为带基数感知帕累托选择的多目标贝叶斯优化（MOBO-CAPS），其目标是识别出一组恰好包含M个且具有高超体积的解。我们提出了两种实用的基数感知采集策略：REHVI，一种考虑替换效应的期望超体积改进近似方法；以及CHO-UCB，通过优化基于集体UCB的超体积目标来构建乐观的M点集合。我们为CHO-UCB的批量版本证明了次线性的简单遗憾界，并通过实验证明基数感知采集（策略的有效性）。
tldr: 该论文提出MOBO-CAPS问题框架及两种基数感知采集策略REHVI和CHO-UCB，可直接高效地选出恰好M个高超体积的解而无需先近似完整帕累托前沿，并为批量CHO-UCB提供了次线性简单遗憾的理论保证。
en_tdlr: This paper formalizes MOBO-CAPS and proposes two cardinality-aware acquisition strategies, REHVI and CHO-UCB, that directly identify exactly M high-hypervolume solutions without wasting evaluations on approximating the full Pareto front, with a proven sublinear simple regret bound for batched CHO-UCB.
